summary: stdout is a self-hostable infrastructure monitoring and incident-management platform built with Astro. It scans networks and services, uses AI (Anthropic and local Ollama models) to diagnose issues and auto-generate documentation, and surfaces everything through dashboards, a knowledge base, and ticketing integrations.

nodes.title: Frontend
nodes.notes: Astro pages and components for dashboards, HUD, setup wizard, docs, status pages and incident UI

nodes.title: Backend
nodes.notes: Astro API routes and lib services handling scanning, diagnosis, monitors, ticketing sync and business logic

nodes.title: Database
nodes.notes: SQLite store with Drizzle schemas and migrations for tenant and central data

nodes.title: Auth
nodes.notes: Session auth, RBAC, licensing, password reset and middleware-based access control

nodes.title: Integrations
nodes.notes: AI diagnosis providers, email, Slack alerts, and ticketing connectors (GitHub, webhook)

nodes.title: Infrastructure
nodes.notes: Docker-based deployment and observatory monitoring/observability stack with sentinel agents
